_about: Judged marks for the parts of the score with no data feed (Claude's; written by the editions, read by tools/score-build.cjs). -1 weighs on the currency, 0 neutral, +1 supports. Change a mark only when something real changes, and say why in `why`.

USD.why: Large US budget deficits and rising debt costs weigh on confidence in the dollar.

EUR.why: Budget strains in some euro-area countries, France above all, weigh on the euro.

GBP.why: UK public finances are tight but not driving the pound right now.

JPY.why: Japan's large debt is well known and not moving the yen right now.

CHF.why: Switzerland's public finances are sound and not a factor right now.

AUD.why: Australia's public finances are not a factor right now.

CAD.why: Canada's public finances are not a factor right now.

NZD.why: New Zealand's public finances are not a factor right now.

USD.why: The US both sells and buys energy, so trade prices do little for the dollar.

GBP.why: Trade prices are not moving the pound right now.

CHF.why: Trade prices are not moving the franc right now.

NZD.why: Firm prices for New Zealand's dairy exports support the New Zealand dollar.
